lib = '''from collections import Counter

def constant_lines(grid):
    """All fully one-color nonzero rows (as ('r', i)) and columns (as ('c', j)) of the grid."""
    H, W = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [('r', i) for i in range(H) if len(set(grid[i])) == 1 and grid[i][0] != 0]
    out += [('c', j) for j in range(W) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(H)}) == 1 and grid[0][j] != 0]
    return out

def _line_color(grid, line):
    """The color of a constant line: the cell it fixes in the grid."""
    return grid[0][line[1]] if line[0] == 'c' else grid[line[1]][0]

def unique_separator(grid):
    """The constant line whose color appears in no other constant line: the grid's divider."""
    lines = constant_lines(grid)
    colors = Counter(_line_color(grid, l) for l in lines)
    return next(l for l in lines if colors[_line_color(grid, l)] == 1)

def split_sections(grid):
    """The two sections on either side of the unique separator line, as equal-shaped row lists."""
    k, n = unique_separator(grid)
    if k == 'r':
        return grid[:n], grid[n+1:]
    return [r[:n] for r in grid], [r[n+1:] for r in grid]

def section_and(grid, new=2):
    """Cells nonzero in both sections of the grid, recolored to new: the overlap of the two sides."""
    a, b = split_sections(grid)
    return [[new if x != 0 and y != 0 else 0 for x, y in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(a, b)]
'''
